coordinatedAdmissionSuccessor: Publish the owning Evidence/plan/store admission successor rather than another opaque trust assertion.

Declare closed byte schemas and canonical encodings for plan-admission and authority-seal-admission receipts, include their exact admitted raw bytes, and authenticate the issuing owner or ledger proof mechanically.

Have opensip-plan recompute PLAN-ID-V1 from the exact admitted resolved-input record; add a typed dependency from the plan receipt to those admitted inputs and reject caller-supplied or cross-project PlanIds.

Have the ProjectId-scoped store/ledger resolve the exact immutable authority object and prove its exact manifest binding. Either implement reviewer-15's sealed terminal Run containing the exact activationManifestRef and RunId, or obtain an explicit coordinated adjudication that authoritatively supersedes that requirement; EP5's silent deferral is insufficient.

Supply only the mechanically verified opaque envelope to the evaluator and define exact D9 failures for every missing, stale, wrong-owner, cross-project, unauthenticated, ambiguous, or manifest-mismatched proof.
regenerateConsistentFixture: Choose one ProjectId and recompute the C2 PlanIntent commitment, Snapshot descriptor/id, PLAN-ID-V1 input/id, manifest/seal raw bytes, semantic refs, bindings, EP graph, RT proof-ref closure, UNIT-ID-V3 values, closure commitment, ownership, availability, and all affected fixtures.

Add an attack that starts from a valid PlanIntent/Snapshot/PlanId for Project A, presents it under Project B, recomputes every locally controlled manifest/seal/binding/closure value, and must still reject at owner admission.
Make the checker mutation derive its alternate ProjectId from the base rather than hard-coding bbbb, so the named negative cannot become a no-op after fixture substitution.
